text:
jamie: quick note — noticed a spike in gateway latency when new client streams start; seems correlated with warmup kernels + admission queuing. repro: ~10s tail spikes for first few tokens. (observed on prod dcs)

suresh: are those spikes during autoscale/eviction windows or every cold-start?

jamie: mostly cold-starts + when we rotate model version. not autoscale. here's sample trace id 0xabc and logs show `kernel_warmup_ms` upticks

elaine: can you paste the minimal span? might be the kv-cache priming. also we don’t currently prioritize warmup tasks vs regular admission.

jamie: pasted trace: 
```
EDGE: accept -> route -> start-runtime
RUNTIME: load-weights 120ms
KERNEL: init 90ms
STREAM: first-token delay 150ms
```

matt: do we have idempotency tokens for streaming handoffs? if retries trigger we might double-warmup and amplify

jamie: good q — currently we attach `x-rdwr-retry-id` on retry but not on first-pass for warmup dedupe

suresh: proposal: treat warmup as a lower-priority admission class with a short debounce window (50-200ms) and share warmup context keyed by (model-version, quant-profile, runtime-hash). if a retry hits while warmup in-flight, return 202 and attach resume-token. avoids duplicate kernel inits.

elaine: +1 but we need metrics: warmup_shares, warmup_dedupe_hits, warmup_queue_delay. also add a circuit to fallback to fast-path (no warmup) after N concurrent warmups per-host.

matt: implementation note: header names `x-rd-warmup-id` and `x-rd-warmup-share`? also ensure trace spans correlate. 

dev-bot: deploy/infra: canary of warmup-debounce landed on hostpool-a at 2023-07-19T12:34:00Z, logs show dedupe_hits 38/120

jamie: nice. follow-ups: (1) validate resume-token semantics with streaming retry tests, (2) add e2e perf test for first-token p50/p95, (3) doc in architecture folder re: warmup keys. I'll file RFC follow-up.

suresh: I'll draft the code changes for admission queue and share RFC link when ready. :thumbsup:
